items.title: Pilgrim Man Carrying a Cloth Bundle
items.alt: A man in a russet doublet, tan breeches and plain felt hat carries a folded linen bundle in both hands.
items.description: A man in a russet doublet, tan breeches and plain felt hat carries a folded linen bundle in both hands. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.
